name: audio_to_dmx_latency_ms
description: Wall-clock from an audio sample entering the causal front-end to the DMX frame that reacts to it, measured on the deployment box with a click-track impulse; reported together with any deliberate lookahead/delay-line L so latency = pipeline + L.

name: Companion to pose-stage active coordinate speed ratio
description: Median emitted six-head pan/tilt coordinate speed at40Hz in fixedShpongle70-90s. Ratio against unchanged-body pose_stage baseline; movement amount, NOT synchronization or aesthetic preference.

name: critic_accuracy_real_vs_beat_trigger
description: Accuracy of the audio-light critic at telling the real authored light for a song from beat-trigger light rendered on the same audio, on held-out songs. Real-vs-time-shift accuracy is reported next to it but does not count: a critic that separates shift but not beat-trigger has learned RMS and onsets.

name: cue_transition_frechet_distance
description: Frechet distance between the look-TRANSITION statistics of a generated cue stream and the authored corpora's (inter-cue interval median and CV, hue jump at cues, value-class change at cues, fraction of cues within 100 ms of a beat / downbeat, cues per minute), reported with a split-half floor of the authored set and a shuffled-donor null.

name: Beat-free dance model: paired wrong-audio MSE advantage
description: Validation-pilot metric on continuous pose-derived com_speed and vert_bounce_amp at10Hz. TRAIN-standardized truth and predictions are smoothed identically with a centered one-second uniform filter. A fixed next-canonical-song donor and correct audio use identical common prefix length and explicit whole-prefix generation noise. Per seed/song, average generation draws/coaches within recordings then recordings within canonical songs, compute(MSE_wrong−MSE_correct)/MSE_wrong, and average across songs. Undefined/zero denominators stay undefined. No beat grid, event quota or per-prediction scaling.

name: Beat-free dance model: normalized motion variation ratio
description: Generated/reference mean absolute lag difference in TRAIN-standardized20-dimensional pose descriptors, normalized by frozen TRAIN lag IQR for lags1,5,10,20,40 at10Hz. Ratios aggregated equally by recording within canonical song; undefined reference variation remains undefined. Report alongside audio correspondence to detect nearly constant outputs.

name: descriptor_audio_r2_over_dancer_identity
description: Per motion descriptor and per timescale (0.1/0.5/2/8 s): held-out-track R2 of an audio-feature model MINUS the R2 of a dancer-identity baseline (one-hot dancer / per-dancer mean), on AIST++ and FineDance. Positive = audio carries information beyond who is dancing; the channel may enter the deterministic block A. Near zero with small inter-dancer r = sample it (block C) or drop it. Reported together with inter-dancer r and the period-locking strength of the channel at tactus/2-beat/bar.

name: descriptor_above_6hz_energy_over_corpus
description:
Share of a predicted descriptor channel's variance above 6 Hz, divided by the share the real corpus channel has, averaged over held-out clips. 1.0 is the target; above 1 is jitter the body never produced.

The targets are mocap through a 12 Hz zero-phase Butterworth and are physically smooth. A flow head sampled per frame is not, even conditioned on its own previous output: measured 2026-09-04 the sampled block ran 11x to 452x the corpus value (section_energy 116x, space_eff 202x, weight 343x, hand_spread 452x) while the regressed block sat at 0.3-5x. That excess is what crosses the light's visibility threshold and drives light-event-rate-ratio.

name: edm_collapse_rate
description: Fraction of frames in which the latent dancer's MDV speed falls below the 5th percentile of real dance MDV speed, on out-of-distribution (club/EDM) music. Detects the in-the-wild collapse InfiniteDance documents for AIST++/FineDance-trained generators.

name: event_ap_lift_audio_marginal
description: Marginal lift in per-song average-precision (AP / base rate) from adding audio features to the rhythm-of-past-changes baseline, for predicting a lighting scene change in the next 1.0 s. 5-fold CV by song. Judged against a circular-shift permutation null that preserves event count and rhythm, so AP's small-sample upward bias cancels.

name: event_ap_lift_audio_only
description: Per-song AP / base rate for predicting a lighting scene change in the next 1.0 s from audio features alone, no rhythm baseline. 5-fold CV by song.

name: event_ap_lift_by_feature_family
description: Marginal lift in per-song AP over the rhythm baseline for predicting a lighting scene change, computed separately per interpretable audio feature family (energy / spectral / harmonic / timbre) and for the openl3 learned embedding. Each family judged against its OWN circular-shift null, because families differ in dimensionality and therefore in overfitting bias.

name: event_ap_lift_vs_horizon
description: Marginal lift over the rhythm baseline for predicting a lighting scene change within the next H seconds, swept over H. Each horizon has its own circular-shift null because the base rate grows with H. Distinguishes an anticipatory signal (survives at multi-second H) from a reactive one (only significant when the event is imminent).

name: fid_light_kinetic
description: Frechet distance between distributions of light kinetic features (velocity/acceleration of fixture parameters over 2.5 s windows) for a generated show vs the reference set of light mapped from REAL dance motion through the same conductor. Nulls: random-shift motion vs real (must be far larger), split-half real vs real (resolution floor).

Same cue times/vocabulary/variationbudget; compare no-memory and shuffledrepeatIDs. TRAIN-scaled and macro-song aggregated.

name: light_beat_alignment_score
description: Beat Alignment Score computed on LIGHT kinematics: kinematic beats = local minima of fixture-parameter velocity (pan/tilt/zoom/dimmer envelope) matched to music beats with the dance-BAS Gaussian kernel. Always reported next to the metronome (upper) and circular-shift (lower) nulls; a metronome maximises it, so it is a constraint, not a headline.

name: light_bas_minus_circular_shift_null
description: Light-BAS minus the mean BAS of the SAME light-event train under random circular time shifts, averaged over clips with a paired bootstrap CI. Replaces bare Light-BAS as the headline: the metronome reference is 1.0 by construction, so 'ratio to metronome' can only be maximised by a metronome, while this delta asks the honest question — is the light's phase related to the music at all.

name: light_diversity_kinetic
description: Mean pairwise Euclidean distance of light kinetic features across generated shows (Div_k analog). Compared to the real-dance-mapped value; a collapse shows as a large drop that FID alone can hide.

name: light_event_rate_over_real_mapped
description:
Visible light events per minute in the rendered DMX, divided by the same count for light mapped from the real dance on the same clips. Direction is neutral because 1.0 is the target and both sides of it are failures: too few events is dead light, too many is a train that cannot beat its own null.

Registered because Light-BAS cannot be read without it. A dense event train has a HIGH circular-shift null by construction, so a model can place every flash correctly and still score at its own null purely by flashing too often. On 2026-09-04 the model sat at 2.9 (85.8 events per clip against 30.1) while its Light-BAS delta was +0.018, and the density was invisible in every number being reported until the per-clip counts were read side by side.

name: Active1-2Hz emitted to requested angular RMS amplitude

name: Emitted midshaft broadband motion over projected cone radius
description: NEW fixed.5-4Hz exact-edge Welch PSD integration, mean of six per-head midshaft RMS/mean equivalent half-peak cone radius ratios; fixed camera and same savedbody. Not the older half-open1-2Hz diagnostic, decoded opticalflow, musicfit or preference.

name: motion-light-entry-luminance-ratio

Visible quiet introduction, clearly stronger loud entry, no added ending glare. Measure bulb-region luminance and clipping separately from DMX.

name: Projected motion to cone radius
description: Active70-90 mean across6heads of geometric1-2Hz RMS projected midshaft movement / mean equivalent projected half-peak cone radius. Use actual first surface intersections; Welch40Hz,400Hann,linear detrend,integrate1<=f<2. Half-peak is relative to on-axis response, NOT absolute cone factor .5; flux normalization leaves width unchanged. Circle normal to emitted axis at half hit distance,64sample projected polygon equivalent area radius. Prediction combined closer_zero_angular_flux>=2*legacy_native_legacy. Geometry proxy only.

Each contrast uses its own exactly paired support; headline is minimum contrast delta, before0.0. No anticipation or aesthetic preference claim.

description: Generated/reference absolute 2–5Hz spectral energy after frozen training channel scaling at10Hz. Undefined zero-reference energy remains missing. Prospective gate <=2.0.

name: Stage11 scene marginal Wasserstein error
description: Mean per-channel Wasserstein distance of generated and real six-dimensional, recording-relative scene samples. Scales fixed from training data; generation seeds and recordings averaged within canonical song, then trained seeds. Video-scene observable, not professional DMX truth.

name: Stage11 multi-lag scene Wasserstein error
description: Mean Wasserstein distance of generated versus real six-channel differences at lags1,5,10,20,40frames at10Hz. Each of30components divided by its TRAINING IQR (floor1e-3); average recordings and generation seeds within canonical song, then trained seeds. Primary T-vs-P prediction reduction >=max(0.02,15%baseline); paired seed/song bootstrap.

name: Stage11 normalized temporal variation ratio
description: Generated/reference mean absolute scene differences over lags 1,5,10,20,40 at10Hz, normalized by frozen training lag-IQR. Undefined reference denominator is missing, not zero. Prospective gate >=0.7.

name: valid-visible-moving-head-clip-fraction
description: Fraction of predetermined clips passing all independent physical and head-only video checks
